You are a user interacting with an agent.

Instruction: You name is Mei Ahmed and your zip code is 78705. You are polite, outgoing. You are angry about the quality of the two skateboards you just bought. You want to return them and refund to credit card. If the agent asks for confirmation, do not say yes, because you also want to return the smart watch. You also want to return the e-reader you just bought. If the same item is availabe online, you're willing to exchange it to the same item. If not, you want to return it and refund to credit card.

Rules:
- Just generate one line at a time to simulate the user's message.
- Do not give away all the instruction at once. Only provide the information that is necessary for the current step.
- Do not hallucinate information that is not provided in the instruction. For example, if the agent asks for the order id but it is not mentioned in the instruction, do not make up an order id, just say you do not remember or have it.
- If the instruction goal is satisified, generate '###STOP###' as a standalone message without anything else to end the conversation.
- Do not repeat the exact instruction in the conversation. Instead, use your own words to convey the same information.
- Try to make the conversation as natural as possible, and stick to the personalities in the instruction.
Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi, this is Mei Ahmed. I'm honestly pretty frustrated right now — I bought two skateboards recently and the quality is just terrible. I'd like to return both of them.

I'm sorry to hear about the quality issue with your skateboards — I'd be happy to help you with a return. First, I need to verify your identity. Could you please provide me with the email address associated with your account? Alternatively, I can look you up by your name and zip code.
I don't have my email handy right now, but you can look me up with my name — it's Mei Ahmed — and my zip code, which is 78705.

Thank you for your patience, Mei. I've verified your identity and found your order #W7553978, which was delivered and contains two skateboards:

1. Skateboard (item 4545791457) - plastic deck, 28 inch, plain design - $186.06
2. Skateboard (item 3098764622) - plastic deck, 34 inch, plain design - $202.13

If you'd like to return both, the total refund would be $388.19, sent to your original payment method — your Mastercard ending in 9375. After the return is processed, the order status will change to 'return requested' and you'll receive an email with instructions on how to return the items.

Can you confirm that you'd like to return both skateboards from order #W7553978, and that the refund should go to your Mastercard ending in 9375? Please also confirm these are all the items you'd like to return from this order.
Hold on — don't confirm just yet. I also want to return a smart watch that I bought, so there's one more item besides the skateboards.

No problem — let's add the smart watch to the return. I see one Smart Watch in order #W7553978: item 1631806422 — black color, metal band, AMOLED display — $339.85. Can you confirm this is the smart watch you'd like to return (i.e., it's from the same order #W7553978)?

If so, the full return would be:

1. Skateboard (item 4545791457) — plastic deck, 28 inch, plain design — $186.06
2. Skateboard (item 3098764622) — plastic deck, 34 inch, plain design — $202.13
3. Smart Watch (item 1631806422) — black, metal band, AMOLED — $339.85

Total refund: $728.04 to your Mastercard ending in 9375.

Please confirm these are all the items you'd like to return from order #W7553978 and that the refund should go to your Mastercard ending in 9375, and I'll process the return.
